defs.meaning: 干预，介入；调停，斡旋；（为改善情况尤指病痛采取的）措施，做法

examples.en: Military intervention will only aggravate the conflict even further.
examples.zh: 军事介入只会使冲突加剧。

examples.en: Many people felt he would be hostile to the idea of foreign intervention.
examples.zh: 许多人觉得他会反对外来干预。

examples.en: Schools are inadequately equipped to implement any intervention.
examples.zh: 学校没有足够的能力来实施任何干预措施。
